sources.title: AI's Frontier Is Moving. Its Legal Definition Should Too
sources.snippet: Policymakers are increasingly concerned about "frontier models," a term meant to identify a small group of highly-capable general-purpose models that could pose unusually serious risks, such as mass casualties or billion-dollar damage.
